newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 moves to new high, notches up 50-pt gain.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 moves to new high, notches up 50-pt gain.

text.p: The FTSE 100 motored to a fresh record peak, notching up a 50 point gain just ahead of the Wall Street opening.
The index was 50.5 points higher at 4,630.9 by 1326 GMT, having touched 4,631.
The Dow is expected to open about 40 points higher with comments made overnight by Federal Reserve chairman, Alan Greenspan, quelling fears of near-term interest rate hikes.
Earlier on Friday the bank and insurance sector pushed the main FTSE index sharply higher. -- Louise Ireland, London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
